[attribute-span]
=== `@span` Span (NISO JATS table model)

The number of columns that will share the <<element-col,`<col>`>> or <<element-colgroup,`<colgroup>`>> element’s attributes. (This attribute is based on and intended to be converted easily to the XHMTL `span` attribute.)

#### OPTIONAL (defaults to 1) on elements:  <<element-col,`<col>`>>, 
                  <<element-colgroup,`<colgroup>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| A counting number| How many columns will have the same attributes, for example,
                        “`3`”.
| Default value| 1 (The attributes are for this column only.)
|===
